gate: extraction F1 on a frozen held-out utterance set; no lesson from a non-directive

claim: A lexicon lesson fixes a mispronounced word and generalizes across sentences
gate: human-rated pronunciation rises; no regression on untaught words (TOST)

claim: One spoken example lets the voice imitate delivery in context
gate: speaker similarity up; WER not worse; humans prefer

claim: Feedback-driven RL beats supervised and untouched baselines
gate: human blind preference sign test; WER and similarity guards

claim: The closed loop removes corrected errors without regressions
gate: corrected-item error falls; held-out unchanged within margin; rollback works

claim: The agent is usable by voice: tools, latency, disclosure
gate: first sound p50 <= 1.5 s and p95 <= 2.0 s over >=3 repeats on an idle card; tool task success within margin of text input

claim: The persona is a trained adapter
gate: adapter beats base and prompted base on the frozen exam
